keySource: The key is NYSED's own, read from the Map to the Standards in the released-items PDF and carried into provenance/itemmap_g6-2026.json by tools/extract_item_map.py. tools/merge_content.py re-checks every letter against that file item by item and refuses to build if one disagrees. It was additionally checked against the transcribed content: item 8's key is P, and P is the point at negative four and a half on this item's own number line, which is the opposite of the four and a half in its stem; item 10's key is 27, and the three points in its graph -- 2 minutes at 18 gallons, 4 at 36, 6 at 54 -- give 9 gallons a minute, so 3 minutes is 27; item 20's key is the only choice whose two comparisons are both true of the transcribed absolute values.

38.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 12 (PDF page 8)
38.check: The coefficient is the numeral multiplying the variable, and this item's own transcribed stem reads 6n^5. The exponent was one of the things grade 6 needed the superscript work for -- flattened it would have read 6n5.

39.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 17 (PDF page 13)
39.check: Negative 9 is further from zero on the negative side, so it is the smaller. Both temperatures come from this item's own transcribed stem, degree signs included.

41.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 22 (PDF page 18)
41.check: 43 + c = 150 gives c = 107. The 150 and the 43 are in this item's own stem, and so is the variable c -- which was landing at the END of the sentence until line grouping was fixed.

42.answer: Each value of y is twice the corresponding value of x. x: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and y: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20
42.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 32 (PDF page 28)
42.check: Starting at 2 adding 2 gives 2, 4, 6, 8, 10; starting at 4 adding 4 gives 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Both rules are in this item's own transcribed stem.

43.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 52 (PDF page 38)
43.check: Splitting the trapezoid gives a rectangle 11.5 by 8.8 = 101.2 and a triangle (15.2 - 11.5) by 8.8 halved = 16.28, totalling 117.48. All three dimensions are legible in this item's figure and named in its long description.

44.answer: Store A, at $2.04 a roll against Store B's $2.18
44.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 62 (PDF page 48)
44.check: 12.24 divided by 6 is 2.04 and 19.62 divided by 9 is 2.18. Both prices and both pack sizes are in this item's own transcribed stem.

45.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 72 (PDF page 58)
45.check: 3(64 - 36) + 7(27) = 84 + 189 = 273. The expression is this item's own transcribed stem, and it is carried entirely by the superscripts: read flat as 3(43 - 62) + 7(2 + 1)3 it is a different calculation.

46.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 82 (PDF page 68)
46.check: 4 and 3/4 divided by 1/3 is 19/4 times 3, which is 57/4 = 14 and 1/4, and a part batch does not count. Both mixed numbers are in this item's own transcribed stem.
